payload.slides_filled:
TEN STORIES WALKED AGAINST THEIR PASS LINES. Eight fill from the shipped system. ONE FILLS ONLY IN PART. ONE CANNOT FILL, and it is a killer — recorded as a finding, which is what this state says an unfillable slide is.

S1 THE GATE THAT REVIEWS ITSELF [KILLER] — FILLED, and by accident rather than by staging, which is the strongest kind.
  Slides 2-4 (the form asks for four rounds it cannot skip): every gate in this iteration was served the four rounds as required fields. Evidence: gate_inputs-4, gate_requirements-2, gate_candidates-3, gate_architecture-2, gate_prototype-2, gate_implementation-1.
  Slide 5 (the verdict is REOPEN and the machine carries it out): TWICE, unstaged. gate_inputs reopened write_stories over three unstoried needs; gate_candidates reopened evaluate_set over a candidate eliminated on an unprobed claim.
  Slide 6 (the owner reads a gate that caught its own author): every one of the six gates produced a finding or a question its author had missed.

S2 THE AGENT WHO STOPS WRITING SCRIPTS [KILLER] — FILLED, demonstrated live this milestone.
  Slide 3 (reach the predecessor system by revision): searched ref `main`, found product/quackitect/method/prompts/engage.md line 64. No checkout.
  Slide 4 (matches carry context in the same call): used throughout this walk; the pass line names ONE call and one call is what it takes.
  Slide 5 (ten places across five files in one atomic batch): done twice — eleven edits across six files for the console-window sweep, and ten edits across five files for the fixture rounds.
  Slide 6 (no script): PARTIALLY. Scripts were still written for the bootstrap promotions, each declared with its gap logged. That is the honest state and it is why the story is filled rather than closed.

S3 THE SECOND AGENT [KILLER] — FILLED for the mechanism, NOT for the scenario.
  Slides 3-4 (promotion under discipline; a red suite commits nothing and the refusal names the failing test): six promotions, five refusals, every refusal restoring trunk untouched. Evidence: 6cfddf0, b91bc8e, c30f023, 5adfe2b, dda426e.
  Slide 5 (both agents run against one judge): UNFILLED, because two agents have never run at once. The mechanism that makes it safe was built this iteration; the scenario awaits a second agent. Recorded rather than claimed.

S8 THE LAW MINTED THIS AFTERNOON [KILLER] — CANNOT FILL. THE FINDING OF THIS STATE.
  Slide 3 (the packet CARRIES the law, resolved): nothing carries it. The applicability join is unbuilt.
  Slide 4 (an unattached rule is reportable): unbuilt.
  So the story's own scenario — four laws minted in one afternoon reaching the agent they bind — is exactly as false at the end of this iteration as it was at the start. Ten notes and four laws were minted today; none of them will reach a packet tomorrow.
  WORSE, AND IT BELONGS HERE RATHER THAN IN A RETRO: this iteration demonstrated the failure ON ITSELF. Its own first pass recorded a decision about version-control grep, and two hours later its rewalk eliminated a candidate on a claim contradicting that decision. Nothing carried the decision to the state that needed it.

S4 THE WRONG ARGUMENT — FILLED. Dispatch refuses a missing required argument naming clause, expectation, what arrived and the remedy; an explicitly empty value is ACCEPTED. Both halves have checks, both were observed red.

S5 THE CHECK THAT DOES NOT PRETEND — FILLED. The lint registry decides or defers; the model-adherence and requirement-field checks DEFER with their reason rather than passing. Deferral is visible in the record.

S6 THE READER SIX MONTHS OUT — FILLED, and USED rather than merely stored. Prior fills are marked superseded with a reopened marker carrying the reason. Slide 5's proof is real: gate_inputs had to open the SUPERSEDED first-pass frame to recover the need register it was judging against.

S7 THE OWNER READING CHAT — FILLED by inspection, which is its declared verify method. Identifiers were expanded in the messages that used them across this session, after the owner's correction.

S9 THE TAG THAT WAS DELETED — FILLED for the mechanism. Annotated tags carry the iteration's goal and closing gate; the grant records the evidence commit hash; the branch is deleted after the merge so one name means one thing. Slide 4's scenario (six months later, tags gone, evidence still reachable) is not exercised — it needs elapsed time and a careless act, and staging it would prove less than the tests already do.

S10 WHO ACTUALLY CHECKED THIS — FILLED THIN, and marked thin. Origin is recorded per check and a computed label without its fact is refused. But the computed SET is small, because the checks that would enlarge it defer on the same blocker as S8. The distinction exists; there is not yet much on the computed side of it.
payload.demos_seeded:
ONE DEMONSTRATION PER KILLER USE CASE. Four killers, three demonstrated, one unfillable.

D1 — THE KILLER SEQUENCE (UC-B, story S2). EXERCISED LIVE IN THIS MILESTONE, three legs, three lane calls, no script:
  Leg one — the design document read BY RANGE: product/spec/bootstrap/se-v2-design.md, 2586 lines total, lines 1-6 returned with the total extent reported. This is the file whose unreadability was the leading suspect for three design-to-build losses.
  Leg two — the predecessor system read BY REF: ref `main`, found product/quackitect/method/prompts/engage.md line 64. Nothing checked out, no declared root needed.
  Leg three — a CLOSED iteration's evidence found by record search: ref `iter/i8c-phone-connect`, found product/spec/ledger/se/raid-answer-forgery.md line 21. That file exists in NO working tree; before this iteration it was unreachable by any tool in the lane.
  VERDICT: PASSES. And the third leg is the one that matters most — since the close-and-merge split, every shipped iteration's record had been invisible to search. It is now addressable by name.

D2 — THE GATE THAT REVIEWS ITSELF TO A REOPEN (UC-A, story S1). EXERCISED TWICE, BOTH UNSTAGED, which is better evidence than a staged run:
  At gate_inputs: the review found three needs with no story, reopened write_stories, the states re-walked, the gate then passed. The superseded fills stayed readable.
  At gate_candidates: the review probed its own freshness veto, found the claim false, reopened evaluate_set, the re-walk restored a candidate AND surfaced a capability gap two passes had missed.
  AND THE PART A STAGED DEMO WOULD HAVE HIDDEN: carrying out the first reopen DEADLOCKED the machine, and the fix for that deadlocked it differently. Both were silent — no error, no escape, no legal move. Both are fixed, covered by a property generated over every state of the real machine, and that property was verified to catch both with the fixes disabled in turn.
  VERDICT: PASSES, and it is the iteration's strongest evidence precisely because nobody arranged it.

D3 — THE SECOND AGENT (UC-D, story S3). PARTIALLY DEMONSTRATED.
  What IS demonstrated: promotion under its four rules, six times, with five refusals that each restored trunk untouched and named what failed. The suite ran green IN TRUNK before every commit.
  What is NOT: two agents running at once against one judge. Never exercised. The mechanism exists and the scenario does not, and I am not calling that a pass.
  VERDICT: MECHANISM PROVEN, SCENARIO UNEXERCISED.

D4 — THE LAW MINTED THIS AFTERNOON (UC-H, story S8). CANNOT BE DEMONSTRATED. Nothing to run. The applicability join is unbuilt and the chunk is drawn as blocked.
  VERDICT: FAILS TO EXIST. This is the iteration's largest gap and its own thesis unmet — recorded here rather than deferred to the retro, because a killer demonstration that cannot be staged is the clearest possible statement of what did not ship.

EXECUTABLE SLICES CONVERTED TO PERMANENT ACCEPTANCE SCENARIOS: D2's two properties (a reopen never strands a gate; a reopened state moves on) are now generated over every state of the real machine and run in the battery forever. D1's third leg is pinned by the ref-search tests. D3's rules are pinned by six promotion tests. D4 has nothing to convert.
